[Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他找很多植物：他找到了很多植物，Here the narration describes plants that he successfully found and then ate. 找 means “look for,” while 找到 means “find”; the resultative complement 到 shows that the search reached its result, and 了 marks the completed event.
